text: National Institute of Technology, Tiruchy-15 Scholarship to UG students Undergraduate students can apply for the scholarship as per the information given in following table. B. Scholarship Sanctioned by Other State Governments for Students hailing from their States 5 Post Metric Scholarship from Other States students  Students are advised to visit Websites of (i ) Social Welfare Department (ii) Scheduled Caste and (iii) Scheduled Tribes welfare websites of respective states from which the student is hailing from.  For example , students hailing from Andhra Pradesh should see the website of Andhra Pradesh Social Welfare/ SC/ ST Welfare Departments’ website only.  Similarly, Students hailing from Gujarat should refer the website Gujarat Government Social Welfare/ Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Welfare Departments’ website.  Students may note that eligibility, parental income and other terms and conditions for sanction of scholarship , amount of scholarship etc., differ from one State to another State.  Scholarship Application should be downloaded from the websites of respective States.  Students may kindly note that mere submission of application by the student does not confer any assurance or guarantee for sanction and getting of the scholarship.  Scholarship S ection, NITT will forward the scholarship application received from the NITT students, to the Social Welfare Departments of concerned State Governments for consideration at their end. Sanction or otherwise of the scholarship is left to the discretion of the Scholarship Sanctioning authority of the respective State Government.  No oral enquiries will be entertained by Scholarship Section, NITT, regarding Sanction or otherwise of the scholarship of the State Government concerned.  As and when the scholarship is sanctioned by the respective State Governments, NITT scholarship section will notify through circular in the Institute website , the names of the students w ho are selected for scholarship . Individual students will also be informed by NITT scholarship section, over phone. C. D. Central Sector Scholarship Scheme of Top Class Education for SC students (This scholarship scheme is implemented by Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. of India) S. No. Name of the Scholarship Eligibility criteria Amount of the Scholarship Procedure for Application Remarks Total Parental Income (Rs) Academic and Other Eligibility Criteria Category 7 Central Sector scholarship scheme of top class education for SC students Total Family Income of the student from all the sources should not exceed Rs. 4.50 lakh per annum The SC students who have secured admission in the Notified institutions are eligible to apply for the scholarship. NIT, Tiruchy is one of the notified institutions. SC students Scholarship will cover the following items viz., (a) full tuition fees and non refundable charges (b) living expenses at the rate of Rs.2,220 per month (c) books and stationery at the rate of Rs.3000 per annum and (d) a Personal Computer Rs.45,000 ( only one time) A Prescribed format of application for this scholarship is given in the file enclosed. Subject to the fulfilment of eligibility conditions , NITT will select the SC students on the basis of merit and shall forward the applications o f the eligible students to the Scholarship Sanctioning Authority. Number of scholarship allocated to NIT, Trichy is 12. Hence, only top 12 students, based on inter se merit will get this scholarship, subject to the fulfilment of Income and other eligibility criteria. The remaining students from SC category admitted in NITT shall be eligible for the Post Metric Scholarship administered by the Ministry as a centrally sponsored scheme. For details please refer the website of Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment , Govt. of India Social justice.nic.in E. Subject to the fulfilment of eligibility conditions, NITT will select the SC students on the basis of merit and shall forward the applications o f the eligible students to the Scholarship Sanctioning Authority. The remaining students from ST category admitted in the NITT shall be eligible for the Post Metric Scholarship (PMS) administered by the Ministry as a centrally sponsored scheme.
